declarations.docstring: The displayed auxiliary values agree when the associated representation modules are linearly equivalent.
A surjective equivariant linear map transfers the displayed auxiliary supremum-equals-top property to its target.
The displayed auxiliary supremum for the auxiliary representation indexed by a natural-valued tuple is top.
Under the stated hypotheses, a representation is isomorphic to the displayed auxiliary representation when their auxiliary values and dimensions agree.
An auxiliary statement whose displayed formal type is unavailable.
An auxiliary statement whose displayed formal type contains an elided term.
Every positive-multiplicity summand in the equivariant direct-sum decomposition has the displayed auxiliary supremum equal to top.
Every positive-multiplicity summand in the equivariant direct-sum decomposition satisfies the specified auxiliary predicate.
Pairwise nonisomorphic simple summands of the decomposition admit an injective labeling whose labels give their displayed auxiliary values.
The displayed auxiliary values of pairwise nonisomorphic simple summands are linearly independent under the stated hypotheses.
An equivariant decomposition into simple summands admits an injective assignment from the displayed index type to summands with the displayed auxiliary values.
A simple module embedded in a finite direct sum of simple modules is linearly equivalent to one of the summands.
Under the stated hypotheses, a simple representation is isomorphic to the displayed auxiliary representation when their auxiliary values agree.
